cases.blocker: Damaged matte, retained magenta/green slab, checker or sheet
cases.recovery: Inspect actual source/subject. Reuse a clean newer candidate or perform bounded local correction. Queue Vertex only when source defects/unsupported local recovery justify it. Preserve before/after pixels.
cases.stopScope: Affected asset; continue other ready work.

cases.blocker: Missing full body, compatible part, pose or hidden ground
cases.recovery: Prepare explicit reference/camera/anatomy/part/geometry guide; request a new complete usable source or missing compatible donor via Vertex. Newly generated material is a new source identity, not recovered original anatomy.
cases.stopScope: Affected generation pack until ready; continue independent rows.

cases.blocker: Generated body still cropped, wrong identity, baked UI/checker, wrong pose/side or invalid parts
cases.recovery: Reject candidate asFAIL, retain raw/output hashes and defect evidence, attempt at most one evidence-directed correction within budget. Full bodies still require joint/gait proof.
cases.stopScope: AffectedID after bounded attempts; no endless retries.

cases.recovery: Generate corrected ground aligned to frozen legal pads/roads/Hall/Wall/bridge anchors and the approved appearance. Measure full physical corridors/entrances/height/uncertainty afterward.

cases.blocker: Geometry or art direction genuinely unspecified
cases.recovery: Publish exact alternatives/measurement and request the missing authority only for that property. Do not invent approved geometry or stop unrelated queues.

cases.blocker: Clean art exists but old runtime still displays defects
cases.recovery: Image validates/reuses clean successor and supplies exact binding/geometry handoff. Code later connects it.
cases.stopScope: Code integration gate; no unnecessary regeneration.

cases.recovery: Owning Image AI prepares these locally from current exact source hashes and canonical contracts. Null historical queue fields and blanket owner guide acceptance are not global prerequisites.

cases.blocker: Unsupported request field/inline input size/SDK version
cases.recovery: Validate wire body against current official API; adapt owned helper offline; shrink only request-reference copies with documented transforms. Never upscale output and claim native resolution.
cases.stopScope: That pack; no paid probe or silent provider switch.

cases.recovery: Confirm intended account/project metadata; refresh existing credentials privately. Record exact denied permission/billing need. Do not change global login/IAM/billing/project settings or keep paid retrying.
cases.stopScope: All paid requests needing that access; local processing continues.

cases.blocker: Active/unknown remote job, lock contention or malformed mutex
cases.recovery: Reconcile the same operation/attempt and ownership using local/remote evidence; wait for verified terminal state. No age-based clearance, force unlock or duplicate POST.
cases.stopScope: All paid submissions across both queues; local work continues.

cases.recovery: PersistUNKNOWN plus full liability/request hash; recover that exact operation/receipt. Do not automatically resend or clear its lock.
cases.stopScope: All paid submissions until reconciled; local work continues.

cases.recovery: Stop the paid run, persistRetry-After/backoff (at least60s), and resume the same pending ID/body only after definite rejection and documented backoff/accounting reconciliation. No hidden automatic retries or another-project fallback.

Reconcile unique attempts/holds without inventing invoices or releasing unknown amounts. Keep reserve/cap; prioritize affordable useful dependencies. Give owner exact shortfall if cap change is required.
cases.stopScope: Unaffordable paid requests; local/affordable work continues.

cases.recovery: Verify sufficient room before dispatch; atomic save raw bytes/new candidate; verify checksum/decode/native size. Preserve receipt/liability if dispatch already occurred; fix path/storage issue and recover same returned bytes. No cleanup of protected files.
Immutable content-addressed pack, one provider coordinator, shared mutex/CAS, durable per-ID receipts and rehash-before-reuse. Actor producer consumes only complete published receipts.

cases.blocker: Missing exact historical guides / owner/device/morale/runtime gate
cases.recovery: Keep exact guides as transfer gaps; use newly named current geometry guides for new generation. Finish Image scope; leave Code/owner/device gates explicitly separate.
